exposure: elective delivery by lower segment caesarean section
Risk quartiles based on developed risk score
cohort: Infants from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC)
finding: A clinical risk score combining seven routine antenatal factors was strongly associated with the risk of HIE, resuscitation, stillbirth, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Elective delivery of high-risk infants at 37 weeks gestation could potentially prevent 14% of all HIE cases.
